---
title: "Demo"
---

<!-- OWNER: Friedrich Commichau -->

So einfach baust du einen 3D Gaussian Splat in deine eigene Webseite ein. Bearbeite den
HTML-Code und die Vorschau rendert ihn live. 
In wenigen schritten kannst du auf jeder Webseite deine Gaussian Splatts rendern.

```{=html}
<style>
  .demo-editor { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin:1rem 0; }
  .demo-pane { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
  .demo-toolbar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .demo-btn {
    padding:6px 12px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid #2a2a35;
    background:#1a1a24; color:#eee; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .demo-btn:hover { background:#26263340; border-color:#444; }
  .demo-btn-primary { background:#2d6cdf; border-color:#2d6cdf; }
  .demo-btn-primary:hover { background:#3a78ea; }
  .demo-label { color:#8a8a9a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .demo-stepper {
    margin:1rem 0; padding:14px 16px; border:1px solid #2a2a35;
    border-radius:8px; background:#11111a;
  }
  .demo-step-head { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .demo-step-num {
    font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#2d6cdf; letter-spacing:.04em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .demo-step-title { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#f0f0f6; margin:0; }
  .demo-step-desc { color:#b8b8c6; font-size:14px; margin:0 0 10px; }
  .demo-step-code {
    margin:0 0 12px; padding:12px; overflow:auto; max-height:240px;
    font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; font-size:12.5px;
    line-height:1.5; tab-size:2; color:#e6e6f0; background:#0d0d14;
    border:1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius:6px; white-space:pre;
  }
  .demo-step-nav { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
  .demo-btn:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; }
  #demo-code {
    width:100%; min-height:120px; resize:none; overflow:hidden;
    font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; font-size:13px;
    line-height:1.5; tab-size:2; padding:12px; box-sizing:border-box;
    color:#e6e6f0; background:#0d0d14; border:1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius:8px;
    outline:none;
  }
  #demo-preview {
    width:100%; flex:1; min-height:360px;
    background:#0d0d14; border:1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius:8px;
  }
</style>

<div class="demo-editor">
  <div class="demo-pane">
    <div class="demo-toolbar">
      <button class="demo-btn demo-btn-primary" id="demo-run">▶ Ausführen</button>
      <button class="demo-btn" id="demo-reset">↺ Zurücksetzen</button>
    </div>
    <div class="demo-label">HTML-Code</div>
    <textarea id="demo-code" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
  </div>


  <div class="demo-stepper">
    <div class="demo-step-head">
      <span class="demo-step-num" id="demo-step-num">Ausgangspunkt</span>
      <h3 class="demo-step-title" id="demo-step-title">Hello World</h3>
    </div>
    <p class="demo-step-desc" id="demo-step-desc">Wir starten mit einer schlichten HTML-Seite.</p>
    <pre class="demo-step-code" id="demo-step-code"></pre>
    <div class="demo-step-nav">
      <button class="demo-btn" id="demo-prev">← Zurück</button>
      <button class="demo-btn demo-btn-primary" id="demo-next">Nächster Schritt →</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="demo-pane">
    <div class="demo-label">Vorschau</div>
    <iframe id="demo-preview" sandbox="allow-scripts" title="Live-Vorschau"></iframe>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
(function () {
  var HELLO_WORLD = [
    "<!DOCTYPE html>",
    "<html>",
    "<head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"></head>",
    "<body style=\"font-family:sans-serif;padding:24px;color:#fff;\">",
    "  <h1>Hello World</h1>",
    "  <p>Bearbeite den Code und die Vorschau aktualisiert sich automatisch.</p>",
    "</body>",
    "</html>"
  ].join("\n");

  // HTML-Gerüst, in das die kumulierten JS-Zeilen eingesetzt werden.
  // %JS% wird durch die JS-Zeilen der Schritte 1..N ersetzt.
  var SCAFFOLD = [
    "<!DOCTYPE html>",
    "<html>",
    "<head>",
    "  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">",
    "  <style>",
    "    html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0d0d14;}",
    "    #c{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none;}",
    "  </style>",
    "</head>",
    "<body>",
    "  <canvas id=\"c\"></canvas>",
    "  <script src=\"https://cdn.babylonjs.com/babylon.js\"><\/script>",
    "  <script src=\"https://cdn.babylonjs.com/loaders/babylonjs.loaders.min.js\"><\/script>",
    "  <script>",
    "%JS%",
    "  <\/script>",
    "</body>",
    "</html>"
  ].join("\n");

  // Jeder Schritt: title, desc, delta (angezeigtes Snippet) und js (kumulierte Zeilen).
  var STEPS = [
    {
      title: "Babylon.js importieren",
      desc: "Ein <canvas> als Zeichenflaeche und die zwei Babylon-Bibliotheken von der CDN. Der Loader registriert die Splat-Formate.",
      delta: [
        "<canvas id=\"c\"></canvas>",
        "<script src=\"https://cdn.babylonjs.com/babylon.js\"><\/script>",
        "<script src=\"https://cdn.babylonjs.com/loaders/babylonjs.loaders.min.js\"><\/script>"
      ].join("\n"),
      js: []
    },
    {
      title: "Szene aufsetzen",
      desc: "Engine an den Canvas binden, eine Scene erstellen, Hintergrundfarbe setzen und die Render-Schleife starten.",
      delta: [
        "const canvas = document.getElementById('c');",
        "const engine = new BABYLON.Engine(canvas, true);",
        "const scene = new BABYLON.Scene(engine);",
        "scene.clearColor = new BABYLON.Color4(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, 1);",
        "",
        "engine.runRenderLoop(function () { scene.render(); });",
        "window.addEventListener('resize', function () { engine.resize(); });"
      ].join("\n"),
      js: [
        "    const canvas = document.getElementById('c');",
        "    const engine = new BABYLON.Engine(canvas, true);",
        "    const scene = new BABYLON.Scene(engine);",
        "    scene.clearColor = new BABYLON.Color4(0.05, 0.05, 0.08, 1);",
        "",
        "    engine.runRenderLoop(function () { scene.render(); });",
        "    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { engine.resize(); });"
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Kamera platzieren",
      desc: "Eine ArcRotateCamera umkreist einen Zielpunkt. Erst mit einer Kamera wird die Szene sichtbar gerendert.",
      delta: [
        "const camera = new BABYLON.ArcRotateCamera(",
        "  'cam', -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2.2, 6, BABYLON.Vector3.Zero(), scene",
        ");"
      ].join("\n"),
      js: [
        "",
        "    const camera = new BABYLON.ArcRotateCamera(",
        "      'cam', -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2.2, 6, BABYLON.Vector3.Zero(), scene",
        "    );"
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Steuerung hinzufügen",
      desc: "attachControl aktiviert Maus- und Touch-Steuerung; wheelPrecision bestimmt die Zoom-Geschwindigkeit.",
      delta: [
        "camera.attachControl(canvas, true);",
        "camera.wheelPrecision = 50;"
      ].join("\n"),
      js: [
        "    camera.attachControl(canvas, true);",
        "    camera.wheelPrecision = 50;"
      ]
    },
    {
      title: "Splat laden",
      desc: "ImportMeshAsync laedt den Gaussian Splat. Der passende Loader wird an der Dateiendung erkannt.",
      delta: [
        "BABYLON.SceneLoader.ImportMeshAsync(",
        "  null, '', 'https://assets.babylonjs.com/splats/gs_Skull.splat', scene",
        ");"
      ].join("\n"),
      js: [
        "",
        "    // Splat laden - der Loader wird an der Dateiendung erkannt",
        "    BABYLON.SceneLoader.ImportMeshAsync(",
        "      null, '', 'https://assets.babylonjs.com/splats/gs_Skull.splat', scene",
        "    );"
      ]
    }
  ];

  // Vollstaendiges Dokument bis einschliesslich Schritt N (1-basiert).
  function buildDoc(upto) {
    var lines = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < upto; i++) {
      lines = lines.concat(STEPS[i].js);
    }
    return SCAFFOLD.replace("%JS%", lines.join("\n"));
  }

  function init() {
    var code = document.getElementById("demo-code");
    var preview = document.getElementById("demo-preview");
    var numEl = document.getElementById("demo-step-num");
    var titleEl = document.getElementById("demo-step-title");
    var descEl = document.getElementById("demo-step-desc");
    var codeEl = document.getElementById("demo-step-code");
    var prevBtn = document.getElementById("demo-prev");
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById("demo-next");
    var timer = null;
    var idx = 0; // 0 = Hello World, 1..STEPS.length = nach Schritt N

    function render() { preview.srcdoc = code.value; }

    function autoResize() {
      code.style.height = "auto";
      code.style.height = code.scrollHeight + "px";
    }

    function syncPanel() {
      if (idx === 0) {
        numEl.textContent = "Ausgangspunkt";
        titleEl.textContent = "Hello World";
        descEl.textContent = "Wir starten mit einer schlichten HTML-Seite.";
        codeEl.textContent = HELLO_WORLD;
      } else {
        var step = STEPS[idx - 1];
        numEl.textContent = "Schritt " + idx + " / " + STEPS.length;
        titleEl.textContent = step.title;
        descEl.textContent = step.desc;
        codeEl.textContent = step.delta;
      }
      prevBtn.disabled = (idx === 0);
      nextBtn.disabled = (idx === STEPS.length);
    }

    function loadCurrent() {
      code.value = (idx === 0) ? HELLO_WORLD : buildDoc(idx);
      render();
      syncPanel();
      autoResize();
    }

    loadCurrent();

    code.addEventListener("input", function () {
      autoResize();
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = setTimeout(render, 600);
    });

    document.getElementById("demo-run").addEventListener("click", render);
    document.getElementById("demo-reset").addEventListener("click", function () {
      idx = 0;
      loadCurrent();
    });
    prevBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (idx > 0) { idx--; loadCurrent(); }
    });
    nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (idx < STEPS.length) { idx++; loadCurrent(); }
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
